messages:
Priya (sales): quick thread to nail down POC scope for Acme Financial. They repeated: long doc summarization, RAG Q&A with citation links, and UI snippet ranking. Need acceptance criteria and model suggestions by EOD.
Tom K.: summary of customer asks: 1) ingest policy + contract corpus (~30k tokens each) and produce executive summary 2) factual Q&A with exact citations 3) sub-second snippet ranking for search UI (mobile). Also wants audit logs + EU data residency.
Rina S.: three technical approaches to evaluate:
- Option 1: native long-context LLM (30k) for single-pass summarization and direct generation. Pros: coherence, fewer steps. Cons: higher inference cost.
- Option 2: chunk -> embed -> retrieve -> answer pipeline. Pros: cheaper, easier to control hallucinations. Cons: possible context stitching issues for summaries.
- Option 3: hybrid: use chunked retrieval + a shorter LLM for final consolidation (can use streaming to reduce p50).
Omar V.: infra constraints: they require private deployment in EU region, KMS/HSM for key material, and no outbound egress to public internet. If they want air-gapped, add ~2 weeks infra prep. Also recommend Dedicated capacity for the rerank/low-latency workload.
Nadia (security): legal flagged: SOC2 + encryption at rest/in transit, logging retention policies, and a data processing agreement. We'll need to provide answers in the security questionnaire; I'll take point.
Priya (sales): ok acceptance criteria proposal (customer-facing):
- Summaries: ROUGE-L >= 0.60 and manual review pass rate >= 90% on 50 sampled docs.
- QA: citation precision >= 0.85 (answers include correct source links), and answer correctness >= 0.80 on their eval set.
- Rerank: NDCG@5 uplift >= 18% vs their baseline, p50 snippet latency < 180ms on Dedicated.
- Security: Private EU deployment + KMS + questionnaire complete.
Tom K.: add extraction tasks: structured extraction exact-match >= 88% for key fields (dates, amounts, clause ids). We'll test via function-calling with schema validation. Example schema we'll exercise:
```json
{"function":"get_transaction_summary","args_schema":{"txn_id":"string","amount":"number","currency":"string","settlement_date":"string","summary":"string"}}
```
Rina S.: evaluation plan (4 weeks):
- Week 0: dataset ingest, index creation (embeddings), baseline runs.
- Week 1: reranker model tuning + offline NDCG eval.
- Week 2: integrate tool-calling for structured extractions + stability tests.
- Week 3: latency tuning on Dedicated, A/B between long-context vs hybrid for summaries.
- Week 4: demo + handoff + SOW sign-off.
Omar V.: risks to call out: on-prem networking (VPN, firewall rules) and cert provisioning for HSM may delay start. Also need DB firewall rules for internal search endpoints.
Nadia (security): action: I'll fill security questionnaire sections on data flows, encryption, and access controls by tomorrow noon.
Priya (sales): action items: 1) Sales to provide expected token volumes so we can price Hosted vs Dedicated (I need numbers today) 2) Eng (Tom/Rina) to produce prompt bank and embed baseline outputs by Wed 3) Infra (Omar) to confirm EU private deployment timeline and air-gap costs 4) Security (Nadia) to return questionnaire answers and required SLA language.
Infra Bot: created POC workspace: https://git.redwood/poc/acme-fin/ and spun up a Dedicated test lane (eu-central-1).
Tom K.: low-level note: prefer trying retrieve+rerank first for Q&A to reduce hallucination surface, keep long-context model in matrix for summary fidelity tests only.
Priya (sales): perfect. I'll send the client this acceptance checklist + proposed timeline and ask for volume estimates. Ping here if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
_meta: slack thread for sales POC scoping; realistic short messages; includes root + replies
